legend.A: Regional mean available; named atlas ROI or cortical aggregate. Boundaries still require pairwise matching.
legend.S: Regional mean available; selected spatial sample, not a complete structure mask.
legend.U: Regional mean available; anatomical label or tissue boundary needs clarification.
legend.P: Regional means published, but native table not yet transcribed into a checked machine-readable input.
legend.T: Region reported in statistical tests only; no regional mean in the audited table.
legend.-: No separately reported measurement in the audited tables. Not evidence of biological absence.

datasets.label: Heiss 2004
datasets.independence: Overlap with older Heiss cohorts and Borghammer controls not established.
datasets.method: HRRT ~2.2 mm. Cortical gray-matter lobar aggregation; small structures sampled with MRI-guided spheres.
datasets.caution: Older comparison column is Heiss 1984, not another independent dataset. Do not inherit the 2004 nuclear labels for those older values.

datasets.label: Heiss 1984
datasets.variants: Two estimators in the same seven people
datasets.independence: Overlap with Heiss 1985 unknown. Re-tabulation in 2004 reuses these data.
datasets.method: CT-guided sampled ROIs. ~8 mm FWHM, 11 mm slices.
datasets.role: Candidate historical convergence; native table extraction pending
datasets.caution: 22 bilateral/midline territories from 43 side-specific sites. Broad thalamus, mixed midbrain and lentiform are not individual nuclei. Native rates must remain separate from 2004 re-scaled comparisons.

datasets.label: Heiss 1985
datasets.population: Four men after ~28 hours on duty with little/no sleep
datasets.measure: Awake absolute CMRGlc; asleep percentage change
datasets.variants: Three nondreamers and one dreamer, kept separate; awake/asleep repeated
datasets.independence: States are repeated measurements; subgroups are 3 + 1, not two four-person cohorts. Overlap with 1984 unknown.
datasets.method: ~8 mm FWHM, 11 mm slices. Regional procedure refers to Heiss 1984.
datasets.caution: Awake is sleep-deprived waking, not a rested normative reference. Whole-brain row is a weighted aggregate of sampled regions.

datasets.label: Borghammer 2012
datasets.variants: WM; global mean (GM); reference cluster. Same subjects.
datasets.independence: Some participants reused from Eggers 2009; overlap of the control subset requires verification. Overlap with Heiss 2004 unknown.
datasets.method: HRRT ~2 mm. Histological atlas warped to individual MRI for eight subcortical structures. Two WM reference VOIs.
datasets.source: Borghammer_etal_2012_Table2.csv; article Methods, Fig.2 and Table 2; https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1600-0404.2011.01556.x
datasets.caution: GM means global mean. Cerebellum is central cerebellar WM. Pooled absolute regional rates cannot be recovered from group ratios. PD rows excluded.

datasets.label: Andersen 2022
datasets.measure: Paired FDG and UCB-J regional normalized uptake
datasets.variants: Two tracers in the same subjects; two age groups. S2 contains age-comparison tests.
datasets.independence: Paired tracers, normalization variants and S2 are not independent cohort replications. Cross-paper overlap unverified.
datasets.method: Bilateral Hammers N30R83-derived atlas ROIs. Geometric-transfer-matrix partial-volume correction in S1.
datasets.role: Paired metabolic–synaptic convergence; additional source, not selected by Heiss authorship
datasets.source: Andersen_etal_2022_TableS1.csv; TableS2.csv; reference_tables/region_labels and errata; article Methods
datasets.caution: S1: 13 regions with means. HIP occurs only in S2 statistical tests. SN expansion is uncertain. Young CBL row has an unresolved published mean/relative-difference inconsistency.
